products.name: 5-AMINO-1MQ
more: A small synthetic molecule (a methylquinolinium compound) that inhibits the enzyme NNMT. It is not a peptide.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA.
Cell and animal studies only. No published human trials.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: AOD-9604
more: A lab-made peptide based on the 176-191 end section of human growth hormone, with one added amino acid.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA.
A small number of early human studies; no authorisation followed. Evidence is limited.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: BPC-157
more: A lab-made peptide of 15 amino acids, based on a fragment of a protein found in gastric juice.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Mostly animal and cell studies. Very few human data have been published.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: CJC-1295 NO DAC
more: A lab-made analogue of the first 29 amino acids of growth-hormone-releasing hormone, without the DAC add-on.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Limited early human data. Evidence is limited.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: CJC-1295 WITH DAC
more: A lab-made analogue of growth-hormone-releasing hormone. "DAC" (drug affinity complex) is an add-on that makes it last longer in the body.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
A few small early human studies; development did not continue. Evidence is limited.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: EPITALON
more: A lab-made peptide of four amino acids: alanine, glutamic acid, aspartic acid and glycine.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Mostly animal studies and small human studies from one research group. Evidence is limited.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: GHK-CU
more: A three-amino-acid peptide (glycine, histidine, lysine) bound to copper.
Widely used in cosmetic skin products. An injectable form is not authorised as a medicine. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Cosmetic and laboratory studies exist; injectable human data are lacking.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: GLOW BLEND
more: A blend of three peptides, BPC-157, TB-500 and the copper peptide GHK-Cu, in one vial.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA.
No human trials of the blend. Evidence for each part is mostly preclinical.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: GLUTATHIONE
more: A three-amino-acid peptide (glutamate, cysteine, glycine) that the body makes naturally.
An injectable form is not authorised as a medicine in Canada or the US.
Human studies are small and mixed. Evidence is limited.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: HGH
more: Human growth hormone made by recombinant DNA technology, also called somatropin. A 191-amino-acid protein.
A prescription-only medicine for specific diagnosed conditions, tightly controlled in Canada and the US.
Extensive human evidence for its authorised medical uses only.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: IGF-1 LR3
more: A lab-made, longer-lasting version of insulin-like growth factor 1, with an extended chain and one changed amino acid.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA.
Used mainly in cell-culture laboratories. No human trials.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: IPAMORELIN
more: A lab-made five-amino-acid peptide that binds the ghrelin receptor.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Early human studies only; it was not authorised. Evidence is limited.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: KLOW BLEND
more: A blend of several peptides in one vial. [Exact contents to be confirmed with Grace: her store page does not list them.]

Blends have no dedicated human trials. Evidence for each part is mostly preclinical.

products.name: KPV
more: A three-amino-acid peptide (lysine, proline, valine) taken from the end of the hormone alpha-MSH.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: MELANOTAN II
more: A lab-made analogue of alpha-MSH, a hormone involved in skin pigment.
Not authorised as a medicine. Health regulators have warned the public about it. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online. [Counsel: recommend delisting.]
Small early studies only; safety concerns have been reported. Evidence is limited.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: MOTS-C
more: A 16-amino-acid peptide encoded in mitochondrial DNA, the small genome inside the cell's mitochondria.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Mostly cell and animal studies; human research is at an early stage.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: NAD+
products.note: Coenzyme (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide), not a peptide
more: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a coenzyme found in every living cell. It is not a peptide.
Not authorised as a medicine by Health Canada or the FDA. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Human research on NAD+ itself is early and mostly small. Evidence is limited.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: OXYTOCIN
more: A nine-amino-acid hormone the body makes. It is also a prescription medicine used in hospitals.
A prescription-only medicine in Canada and the US.
Extensive human evidence for its authorised hospital uses only.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: PT-141
more: A lab-made seven-amino-acid peptide, also called bremelanotide.
The active ingredient of a prescription medicine authorised in the US. Other versions are not that medicine.
Human trials exist for the authorised medicine only.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: RETATRUTIDE
more: A synthetic peptide designed to bind three hormone receptors: GLP-1, GIP and glucagon.
Investigational. It is not authorised as a medicine anywhere. Named in Health Canada's 2026 public advisory on peptides bought online.
Still in clinical trials. Published human data are from trials that are not finished; evidence is incomplete.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]

products.name: TB-500

products.name: TIRZEPATIDE
products.note: GLP-1/GIP dual receptor agonist class peptide
more: A synthetic 39-amino-acid peptide that binds two incretin hormone receptors, GLP-1 and GIP.
The active ingredient of prescription medicines authorised in Canada and the US under brand names. A product sold outside those authorisations is not the authorised medicine.
Large randomised human trials exist, but that evidence belongs to the authorised medicines, not to other versions.
Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) powder in a sealed glass vial. [Storage wording to be confirmed with Grace's supplier.]
